paragraphs.text: Apple Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness
# Liquid Glass — a theme for DeepSeek Harness
**简体中文** · README.zh.md

A frosted-glass rewrite of the DeepSeek Harness interface: real SVG edge
refraction on the controls

you touch, a wallpaper you choose, and a session bar
that shares the window's own title bar instead
of stealing a row of its own.

> ### 🤖 Written end-to-end by an agent
>
> Every line of this plugin — the client bundle, the deskto

p chrome work, the smoke
> tests and these docs — was written **autonomously by the DeepSeek V4.1 Fl

ash agent
> running inside the DeepSeek Harness desktop app**. No human-written code.
>
> It worked

the whole time inside the app it was theming: reading the harness's own
> bundles to find real DOM a

nchors instead of guessing selectors, driving its own
> edit → build → test → typecheck loop, and ch

ecking each change against the bundle
> the running window was actually serving. See How this was bu

ng each change against the bundle
> the running window was actually serving. See How this was built.

> ## ⚠️ Please use **dark mode**
>
> This theme is designed for dark mode and it is the only mode it

looks right in.
> The whole point is translucent glass over your wallpaper — in **light mode** a
>

bright wallpaper leaves the glass washed out and the text on top of it hard to
> read.
>
> The theme

does darken the light-mode secondary/tertiary greys to recover some
> contrast, but that is a mitig

ation, not a fix. **If you use light mode, expect
> readability to suffer.** Switching DSH to dark m
ode fixes it completely.
## What you get
### Desktop build

- **The session bar *is* the title bar.** DSH's own header stacks the 对话/轨迹
tabs on a second row, 76

px tall. This theme moves the whole bar into the 40px
system caption — same row as 应用菜单/编辑 and the w

indow buttons — and lays it
out as one line. **You get that vertical space back**: the transcript st

arts
40px from the top instead of 56px, and the tab buttons become small rounded
buttons instead of

oversized glass capsules.
- **A fullscreen button.** DSH's desktop build ships no fullscreen entry p

oint at
all — the frameless caption only has minimize/maximize/close, no F11 or
`togglefullscreen` a

ccelerator is registered, and the main process never calls
`setFullScreen(true)`. The theme contribu

tes a 28px button in the header that
requests document fullscreen and toggles back out; the icon fol

lows the state,
and DSH's own fullscreen-aware layout takes over from there.
- **The caption band is

frosted too**, top-down, exactly like the session bar —
the strip is no longer a flat translucent r

ectangle.
- **Panels that used to be see-through now have a background**: the choice dialog
(the pan

el DSH shows when it asks you to pick an option), the file preview that
appears when you hover a row

in the "已编辑 N 个文件" card, that card itself, and
the question/answer receipt bubble in the transcript

. Each gets a blur plus a
glass fill at a readable opacity.
- **Readable light-mode text** (within t

he limits of the note above): the
secondary / tertiary / caption greys are pushed one to two shades

ts of the note above): the
secondary / tertiary / caption greys are pushed one to two shades darker.
### The glass itself

- **Genuine edge refraction**, not just blur. An `feDisplacementMap` filter bends
what is behind eac

h surface at its rim, the way thick glass does. It rides the
composer card, the send button, message

bubbles, the queue dock, dialogs,
menus and sidebar buttons. **Strength is a slider** — 0 turns it

off, 1 is a
full lens.
- **Every glass parameter is yours**: glass tint colour, tint opacity, materi

al
brightness, frost blur radius, edge refraction strength, and the code-block
opacity. All of it ap

plies live — no reload, no restart.
- **Glass-lens buttons** and the **water-drop settings icon** th

at replaces the
stock gear.
### The wallpaper

- **Six sources**: none, a web URL (iframe, with an optional host proxy for sites
that send `X-Frame

-Options`), a local HTML file, a local image, a local video,
or the **built-in animated demo wallpap

er** that works out of the box.
- **Independent background controls**: wallpaper blur and wallpaper

brightness are
separate from the card frost, so you can keep the background soft while the
glass sta

ys crisp.
- **The demo wallpaper is tunable**: speed, blob count, colour cycling, blob blur
and opac
ity, plus a background wash toggle.
### Everything else

- **One-row header** even on the web GUI — sidebar toggle, conversation title,
then the tabs, the "o

pen in…" dropdown and the right-sidebar toggle all on one
line.
- **Nothing fights your other plugin

s.** The model-selection list is left exactly
as DSH ships it (an earlier version restyled it, which

collided with other theme
plugins), and hover styling is deliberately scoped to the surfaces this t

heme
actually changes.
- **A dedicated settings page** — "Liquid Glass" is a top-level section besid

e
General / Model / Plugins, with live preview and a one-click reset.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility and deliberate choices

| Harness | `≥ 0.1.2-rc.1`, including the `0.2.x` desktop runtime |
| Surfaces | Web GUI and the des

ktop app (same client bundle) |
| Peer packages | the five `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` packages, dec

lared as **optional** peers over `^0.1.2-rc.1 \|\| ^0.2.0-0` |
| Model-selection list | **left to DS
H.** An earlier release restyled it; other theme plugins style the same menu and the two overwrote e

ach other, so the theme backed off |
| Hover styling | scoped to the composer, queue dock, dialogs/m

enus, view tabs and sidebar only — it will not restyle another plugin's controls |
| Light mode | su

pported, but the glass reads washed out — see the note at the top |
| DSH tooltip bug | **known harn
ess bug**, reproduces without this theme: hovering the send button or the context-percentage button
scrolled the page to the top. The theme works around it by switching `container-type` off on three c

omposer/transcript boxes, which costs four narrow-window layout tweaks — see CHANGELOG.md |
| Settin
gs storage | `localStorage` (per browser) |
### Why localStorage

The harness settings gateway exposes only hard-coded product namespaces to
browser clients, so a thi

rd-party namespace stays `loading` forever even when the
host half registered it. The shipped appear

ance and skin plugins hit the same
wall and also use `localStorage`. The trade-off is that settings

do not follow you
between browsers.
